# Full push and native products implementation

Active user mandate (2026-11-12): implement the complete source-to-executable push path and LLVM optimization plus emission incrementality together. The earlier emission-only feasibility plan is not an accepted endpoint. Keep ordinary optimization quality, independent Verify, budgets, error ordering, and all measured scenarios. No default research enablement or main merge.

Isolated branch `research/full-push-native`; base b7703b95a59cc87dd1ac13ce6f652386ea4dfd0d merged current main 42f0396f36b2a36860ecb55371d436e4327877a4 as b3c918149f84ed1f65608781d104561a007ec4f9. Original research and other worktrees remain intact. Current main is newer than the old 99035931 measurements: those numbers are historical, not this candidate's performance.

Implemented checkpoints, not whole-task acceptance:
- Persistent typed/plan/LIR function tables with exact immutable owners, changed-subtree traversal and a separate versioned structural product identity. Legacy Wire bytes/digests preserved. Dense middle insertion/removal still rebuilds/reindexes.
- Transactional reactive scheduler, activity closure and rollback. Independently reviewed clone-history and first-error defects fixed. DB API alone is not a production consumer.
- Expand sealed change batches and Types actual sparse name/CFG consumers for proved contexts; unknown declarations/effects use current full checker. Position rebasing and global/complex work remain.
- Root wiring under explicit default-off `--push-reuse` in progress; Analyze, independent Verify, Lower and LLVM work are being integrated. No end-to-end speedup claimed yet.

Root owns shared IR, driver, Cargo/schema, integration and the only build/measurement window. Authors have distinct new worktrees. Raw logs are currently in this worktree's `out/runs`; they are local and not yet a cross-environment archive. Source checkpoints are pushed to the research branches. Previous frozen 900 evidence remains recoverable from archive/source-history@32e1b04fb859440bb36ec3223cb35b26edf63041; the earlier lost environment raw is still unavailable.

Checks so far: current-main integration check02 passed; persistent IR test04 passed 105 tests; integrated IR/Expand/Types run01 passed 424 tests, including actual 425-function delta/fresh controls; DB run01 passed 38 unit plus 1 compile-fail doc test. First failures and later runs have distinct files. These totals overlap and must not be summed as unique coverage. Full current workspace and native comparison are pending.

LLVM SDK headers extracted only after validating official archive 1190060068 bytes / SHA256 efdd1dbd089b99bfcfcde7b8eb1236163f2e88df5a981cca4f783ec9cb5e0378; source commit 7a941dfb2877a0b8cf30323fefa85ad019e0b0f5. Original installed DSO remains the quality control. ThinLTO/ORC/Zig references do not establish generic function-level O2 replay; every implemented replay needs actual optimizer and codegen dependency closure.

Current checkpoint 4d90add5117cf4d68c3f9cbdd435c381819bf692 pushed/read back. Actual driver 425-function private edit and current semantic cache restore tests passed (push-driver-consumers-01). Expanded integrated run02: Analyze 292, Types 87, Verify 644 passed; Expand 96 passed/5 failed and Driver 197 passed/5 failed. Retain failure logs: shared-scalar fallback panics, old deep-clone work assertions, and a real adjacent-function invalidation regression (21 computed vs required 1) require fixes; no whole-workspace pass claim. Full workspace run01 hit disk exhaustion during linking and executed no accepted test suite. Only disposable prior recovery checkout and validated downloaded SDK archive removed; originals/remote v4 evidence retained.

Intermediate raw now remotely preserved at archive/source-history@b122d56f2a13a3e710ce3e56cdb70df6f843f037 under research/incremental-demand-full-push-20261112-v5. Fresh HTTPS recovery verified all 194 files / 7,745,404 raw bytes, compressed SHA256 da16160f46b845cb406fc3299ad41d5be6662614097e4feca0f8c39027c4bba4. See tools/research/incremental-demand/full-push-recovery-v5.json. Active main42 release build and subsequent work are outside this intermediate archive. The original old-environment raw remains lost; v4 and v5 have distinct scopes.

## Current exact checkpoint 2f9ada619 (2026-11-12)

Source pushed/read back: 2f9ada6193401865043386be00b115eb8db81490. Main still 42f0396f36b2a36860ecb55371d436e4327877a4; goal was 5dc485da8b59431e75a102bdbbc553677f3f0df9 when read. Production integration now includes actual sparse signature consumers, exact retained Types/Analyze owner checkpoints, independent current Verify products, Lower, persistent function tables and changed-row publication. Driver 425 private/restore/broad-history controls: 3 passed. Latest Types 91 and Analyze 294 passed. These overlap prior tests.

Feature `native-products` and runtime `--push-reuse` remain opt-in. Actual original LLVM function pass groups can consume saved outputs; original machine pass pipeline can consume current-owner MIR/X86 state and still run current emission providers/AsmPrinter. SDK extension v6 built from pinned LLVM23.1.4 source. Native five consumer tests and complete LLVM API library 50 passed (overlap), including late-failure fresh retry and cancellation. Warm two-function control reused two optimization groups and two machine functions, skipped 250 machine passes, and matched complete object bytes against ordinary compilation with the SAME patched DSO. This is not an original-SDK quality oracle or a 425-function speed result.

Known v6 correctness boundary: LLVM Function NextBlockNum/BlockNumEpoch and BasicBlock.Number are not in prior text/bitcode binding. Exact state extension is being implemented for v7. Most optimization groups still execute because cached analysis identities do not bind actual analysis values; PI-only admission is conservative but not a generic endpoint. Rich functions, calls, memory, spills, module/CGSCC work and all residual global frontend work remain open. Native parent history currently retains only the latest unit map and can discard useful raw products on a cached parent; bounded successful raw-owner history is being implemented. No old Verify authority is retained.

Both full workspace attempts failed from linking disk exhaustion; no whole-workspace pass claim. New workspace_tests.py preserves all original tests/features/assertions in 33 disk-bounded groups, rejects changed compiler inputs, and removes only Cargo-reported test executables after successful groups. Full run/fmt/strict Clippy remain pending. Failed logs retained. Release build 01 succeeded in 167.9s, source/tree bound, binary SHA256 0903b353c7d2b8b3deec8a3495210b8689ab42306602c58bc366529abde31219, copied under out/binaries/2f9ada6193401865043386be00b115eb8db81490. Compiler build duration is not workload performance.

Raw v5 remote archive remains recoverable; later v2-v6 SDK receipts/sources, actual v6 DSO, review receipts and completed logs are prepared in out/evidence/full-push-checkpoint-02, still local until the next archive push/fresh-download verification. No cross-environment persistence claim for this new snapshot yet.

425 native diagnostic completed in profile-02: 34 requests / 18 measured / 180 native executions, all expected outcomes, all 15 successful paired whole ELF bytes equal against original-SDK main42. Candidate-only profiling (main lacks the profiling flag) means this is NOT a matched timing result; generated raw ratios must not be interpreted as formal performance. Initial profile-01 unknown CLI option failure retained. Private candidate 921.6ms includes 204ms fresh retry after MIR failure; all 378 function optimizer groups executed, zero reused. Current Types/Analyze each about1ms, CT42.5ms, Verify20.8ms, machine15.5ms, diagnostic36.2ms, link-discovery79.3ms. Precise small results in full-push-diagnostic-v6.json.

Original 425 generated bodies fn6/fn7 reproduced MIR failure in test native-products-scalar-repro-01 (0pass/1fail, retained). Exact MIR text differing at offset1339: old machine basic-block numbering follows historic IDs while MIR parser reassigns layout-order IDs. This is a failing regression, not a benchmark substitution. A complete MachineFunction numbering/table restoration is in progress; full-output comparison remains strict. v7 SDK successfully built and strict two-leaf test09 passed, but actual scalar regression still fails. New bounded native history source db1e8a93a integrates four raw epochs/128MiB optional logical payload; tests pending.

# Incremental producer continuation

User authorized a new research branch continuing incremental compilation. Later
steering explicitly requires actual main and Rust comparisons, not comparison
against another active research worker. Implementation and measurement follow
that scope; no main merge or default enablement.

- Branch: `research/incremental-demand-propagation`.
- Historical starting point: `ea0ce45741fde0082b6c92173b7480b167c888d4`.
- Formal baseline: actual main `99035931d358add0eaed6d4535035c38413701dd`.
- Frozen measured compiler: `0601b9786d0fe683b4321f0d086230e5be027602`.
- Delivery report/protocol/reproducer: `tools/research/incremental-demand/`.
- Primary raw evidence: `out/runs/main-matrix-r1`; Rust check and normal
  incremental CGU256 O2: `out/runs/rust-main-check-r2` and
  `out/runs/rust-main-cgu256-r1`. Ordinary CGU16 supplement is separate.

Implemented immutable shared CoreModule/SourceMap assembly and sealed scalar
materialization receipt replay. Current environment admission, budget accounting,
first diagnostics, independent Verify and richer-domain fallbacks remain. A
query-history identity bug was reproduced and fixed. Default-worker stack tests
also exposed a regression inherited from the research base relative to main;
private state/report heap storage and separated frames fixed it without changing
stack size, budgets, depths or assertions.

Independent source review accepts exact 0601. Exact-source workspace lib1654,
LLVM API generic214, strict all-targets Clippy, fmt and release build pass. Earlier
full-workspace run passed6119/failed1; the original sole stack failure is fixed
and revalidated in the full generic suite. Do not claim the whole workspace was
rerun after the storage fix. Raw failures and successful followups remain in
unique validation `out/runs/` directories.

Six paired blocks show reliable main-to-candidate check gains for private and
three-file edits. Actual materialization/Lower work is1/3modules with21/19shared
modules, zero map-entry copies and unchanged CFG counts. This is a whole-branch
comparison, not isolated attribution to the continuation patch. Main already has
substantial caches. Graph B-to-C gain remains unproven. CGU1 O2 multi-edit
regression and negative/incomplete configurations remain visible. Rust is a
separate workflow/timing window with different assurance and partitioning;
cross-language median ratios are descriptive only.

Keep one heavy build or measurement at a time, independent target directories,
frozen binaries/helpers during each run, and named-parent/Source/native outcomes.
Legacy tree-named RSS fields only observe the root in this environment; retain
raw names but do not claim process-tree or Rust memory advantage. Long-session
controls are finite entry/source bounds, not byte bounds or leak proofs.

The former base-cost profiles remain provenance/diagnosis only. The accepted
delivery is a bounded research result with reproducible evidence, not closure
of the general incremental compilation or Rust parity goals. Final numbers,
hashes, review receipts, caveats and archive index are in the delivery report.

> Current checkpoint (2026-11-12): compiler b5e9c8843, SDK15, native16 60/0/0, strict native-products Clippy04 and measurement tools38 pass. 5. 只有inference借用、CT unchanged和shape identity整条链成立才把生产者函数版本传入PreparedProgram，再接现有owner graph和CFG内容缓存。图值需承载真实模块产物；未变模块不需重新提交所有函数输入。CoreProgram仍是Vec值表示，组装可能深clone，必须另计实际Clone/Rebase节点，不能报零AST访问。
